hooks.name: amadeus-audit-reconcile
hooks.description: Amadeus additive actor stamping for gate approvals. After shell tool calls (the conductor runs `aidlc … approve`, which emits the core GATE_APPROVED audit row) reconciles the plugin actor ledger (audit/amadeus/gate-actor.jsonl) against the canonical GATE_APPROVED rows and regenerates the human digest audit/amadeus/audit-trail.md. Runs through the installed aidlc command, which loads <leaf>/hooks/aidlc-amadeus-audit-reconcile.ts. Level-triggered, idempotent, NON-BLOCKING (always exits 0). The AI-DLC audit trail itself is AWS core; this adds only the approver attribution core omits.
